text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...*yaaaawn*... So sleepy...
My body feels so heavy...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'm still tired from yesterday's race...
Even so, the other girls who ran with me
all seem so full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Is it because I haven't reached my prime yet, after all...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-All right! I'm gonna eat a big lunch
and do a whole bunch of training~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What should I eat today, I wonder~?
Everything looks... *yaaawn*... so delicious...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawawawawawa!? W-Was I just asleep on my feet~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Aaah~?! The food...! Don't tell me... what my hand brushed against just now was...!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, goodness!
Is everyone alright? Did your uniforms get dirty?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'm so sooorryyyy!!
I-I-I went and dropped the food...!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, we can just remake the food.
Go grab a new tray.
Come on, lunch break is going to end!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Auuu~ I am so, so, so sooorryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... uuu, I'm clumsy, slow, and sluggish,
yet here I am falling asleep...
and causing trouble for everyone...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh~... Waaaaaaaah!
I'm so stupid, stupid, stupiiid~~~~~~!
